description: This file defines an Android activity 'GridExampleActivity' that displays a grid of fragments with dynamically generated backgrounds, including a nested adapter class 'MainAdapter' and a fragment class 'MainFragment'.

classes.name: GridExampleActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying a grid of fragments with custom backgrounds.

classes.name: MainAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing grid pages and their backgrounds.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: A fragment representing individual grid cells with title and text.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and configures the grid pager.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the grid.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns for a given row.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns a fragment for a specific grid cell.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the background drawable for a specific grid cell.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MainFragment with specified row and column.
